meta.title: Lightpanda CDP
meta.description: Drives a remote Lightpanda headless browser over CDP: open a page, read it as markdown, list interactive elements, click or fill, capture a PNG, and evaluate JavaScript. Tabs live inside one warm connection, so target ids stay usable between calls. Needs a reachable Lightpanda server (default lightpanda:9222) and a loopback Host header, which the config supplies.
